$comment: Statement of intent for review. No tool reads this file; the variables and constants named here are what apply it. The policy is soft (ADR-027): it binds the model, not the operator.

vault.$comment: Nothing here goes through execute_payment, a treasury, a policy or a session. The desk is the operator's own mainnet wallet.

flags.$comment: Public variables, inlined into the bundle at build time. The template is off unless the first is 1, and an empty allow list allows nobody.

limits.$comment: Constants of the template (CLOAK_PAYOUT_LIMITS in packages/contract/src/template-run.ts), not fields of the model's proposal. 0.01 SOL is Cloak's own minimum for a shield and for a swap.

delivery.SOL: relayed withdrawal from the pool to the payee

ZEC.how: private swap of SOL into the verified wrapped ZEC mint, to the payee's token account
ZEC.minOutput: the Jupiter quote at approval time, minus 2%

refuses: a payee equal to the funder
two payouts of the same delivery to the same address
a reserved address: System Program, incinerator, SPL Token, Token-2022, Cloak's program, the ZEC mint
a run when mainnet is off or the connected wallet is not on the allow list

cloakExit.appliesTo: every payout, whether a withdrawal or a swap

fees.$comment: The buffer is a guess until a mainnet run measures it.

keys.source: the wallet's signature over a fixed message, through HKDF
keys.persisted: nothing secret: signatures of finished steps and a 16-hex-character key fingerprint, in localStorage
keys.viewingKey: registered with Cloak's relay by the SDK; the accountant gets the CSV, never the key
